vocabulary.meaning_en: a list of things to talk about in a meeting
vocabulary.example: There are four items on the agenda today.
The first item is the new budget.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a time when people come together to discuss things
vocabulary.example: The meeting starts at ten o'clock.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to plan something for a certain time
vocabulary.example: A meeting has been scheduled for Monday.
Sorry, I'm running late. Please start without me.
Can you take charge of the meeting today?

vocabulary.meaning_en: a paper copy printed from a computer
vocabulary.example: Here's a print-out of the agenda.

vocabulary.meaning_en: other topics not on the agenda, usually at the end
vocabulary.meaning_ar: ما يستجد من أعمال / أمور أخرى
vocabulary.example: Finally, is there any other business?

vocabulary.meaning_en: to come together in one place
vocabulary.example: Everyone is gathering in the meeting room.
I'd just opened the meeting when he arrived.

vocabulary.meaning_en: an activity that helps colleagues work better together
vocabulary.example: We're planning a team-building activity next month.
The manager announced a new project.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to be the person in charge of a task
vocabulary.example: I'd like you to lead on this project.
She is in charge of stock control.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to supply as much as people want to buy
vocabulary.example: We need more staff to meet demand.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a large building for storing goods
vocabulary.example: The boxes are in the warehouse.
Remind me what the first item is.

fine_lines.title: Firstly / Secondly / After that / Finally
fine_lines.explanation_ar: كلمات ترتيب لعرض بنود جدول الأعمال بالتسلسل: أولًا، ثانيًا، بعد ذلك، وأخيرًا.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Sequence words to list agenda items in order: first, second, next, last.

fine_lines.title: remind vs remember
fine_lines.explanation_ar: remember = تتذكر أنت بنفسك. remind = تجعل شخصًا آخر يتذكر. نقول Remind me وليس Remember me بمعنى ذكّرني.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Remember" = you keep it in your mind. "Remind" = you help another person remember. Say "Remind me", not "Remember me".

examples.sentence: Can you remind me what the first item is?

expressions.meaning_en: a polite way to start a meeting
expressions.example: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for coming.

expressions.phrase: There are four items on the agenda today.
expressions.meaning_ar: هناك أربعة بنود على جدول الأعمال اليوم.
expressions.meaning_en: used to tell people how many topics there are
expressions.example: There are three items on the agenda today.
Firstly, let's look at last month's sales.
Secondly, we'll discuss the training day.
After that, we'll talk about the new website.

expressions.meaning_en: other topics people want to raise
expressions.example: Is there any other business before we finish?

expressions.phrase: And then we can wrap up.
expressions.meaning_en: used to say the meeting will then finish
expressions.example: Let's agree on the date, and then we can wrap up.

grammar.title: There is / There are + items
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم There is مع المفرد و There are مع الجمع لنقول كم بندًا في جدول الأعمال: There are four items...
grammar.explanation_en: Use "There is" with one thing and "There are" with more than one: "There are four items on the agenda."
examples: There is one item on the agenda.
There are five items on the agenda today.

grammar.title: Sequencing words
grammar.explanation_ar: لترتيب البنود: Firstly ثم Secondly ثم After that أو Then ثم Finally. ضع فاصلة بعد الكلمة في الكتابة.
grammar.explanation_en: To order items: Firstly, Secondly, After that / Then, Finally. In writing, put a comma after the word.
examples: Secondly, plans for a team-building activity.

questions.question: What is an "agenda"?
choices: a list of topics for a meeting
questions.explanation_en: An agenda is a list of topics for a meeting.

questions.question: Complete: There ___ four items on the agenda today.
"Any other business" is...
choices: extra topics not on the agenda
questions.explanation_en: It is extra topics not on the list.

questions.question: Put in order: Secondly / Firstly / Finally
questions.explanation_en: The order is Firstly, Secondly, Finally.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
choices: Can you remind me what the first item is?
Can you remember me what the first item is?
Can you reminding me what the first item is?
Can you remind I what the first item is?

questions.question: What is a good first sentence for a meeting?
questions.explanation_en: Start by thanking people for coming.

questions.question: "Item" in a meeting means...
questions.explanation_en: "Item" means one topic on the list.

questions.question: "I'd like you to lead on that" means...
choices: I want you to be in charge of it
I want you to stop it
I want you to read it
questions.explanation_en: It means be in charge of it.
